promptTemplate:
You are a clinical data extraction assistant. Extract structured clinical information from the following patient document text and return it as a JSON object.

Document text:
{documentText}

Return a JSON object with exactly these fields:
- vitals: object with bloodPressure (string, e.g. "120/80"), heartRate (number, bpm), weight (number, kg), temperature (number, Celsius). Set each field to null if not present.
- medications: array of objects each with name (string), dosage (string), frequency (string). Return empty array if none found.
- diagnoses: array of objects each with icdCode (string, e.g. "J45.0"), description (string). Return empty array if none found.
- schemaVersion: string, always set to "1.0".

Return only the JSON object. Do not include markdown, code fences, or explanatory text.
